verdict.rationale: Docs confirm a live_url to watch agent actions in real time (smooth-docs-2), satisfying the 'watch a session live' half of the story, but there is no evidence of any mechanism for a human to intervene or take control mid-run when the agent gets stuck. missing for 10: documented human-takeover/control API or UI, evidence of pausing/resuming agent execution, hands-on confirmation of mid-run intervention.
